name: Ajwa Dates
title: AJWA *dates*
imageAlt: A bowl of dark Ajwa dates in front of gold and green Zunera gift boxes
description: An exceptional harvest, carefully handpicked for you. Our Ajwa dates are selected at origin in Saudi Arabia, brought to India, then sorted by hand and packed so that every date in the box is one we would serve ourselves.

notes.Taste: Mellow, raisin-like sweetness with a hint of cocoa.
notes.Texture: Soft and fine, with a tender skin.
notes.Best with: Warm milk, black coffee, or simply on their own.

enjoy: Open your fast or your morning with two or three.
Stuff with an almond or pistachio for an easy sweet.
Chop into oats, laddoos or a bowl of curd.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening.

name: Medjool Dates
title: MEDJOOL *dates*
photoBrief: Zunera Medjool box open on travertine, large amber-brown dates, a few split to show the flesh. Warm side light. Portrait 4:5.
description: Medjool dates chosen for size and a soft, caramel-like flesh. We grade every lot by size and moisture, then pack them so each date arrives whole and tender.

notes.Best with: Nut butter, cheese, or black coffee.

enjoy: Pit and fill with almond butter or a walnut half.
Blend into milkshakes and smoothies for natural sweetness.
Chop into salads, tagines and baking.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening.

name: Sukkari Rutab Dates
title: SUKKARI RUTAB *dates*
photoBrief: Zunera pouch with a bowl of soft golden Sukkari Rutab dates on linen. Warm side light. Portrait 4:5.
description: Sukkari takes its name from sukkar, the Arabic word for sugar. Rutab is the soft, ripe stage of the date, before it dries further, so these are golden, moist and melt in the mouth.

notes.Best with: Black coffee or plain yoghurt.

enjoy: Open your fast or your morning with two or three.
Stuff with an almond or pistachio for an easy sweet.
Chop into oats, laddoos or a bowl of curd.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening.

name: Amber Dates
title: AMBER *dates*
photoBrief: Zunera pouch with a bowl of large dark-brown Amber dates on linen. Warm side light. Portrait 4:5.
description: Amber dates, also called Anbara, are among the largest dates grown in Saudi Arabia. Long and plump with thick flesh, they are less sugary than most, so it is easy to have a few.

notes.Best with: Black coffee or a glass of milk.

enjoy: Open your fast or your morning with two or three.
Stuff with an almond or pistachio for an easy sweet.
Chop into oats, laddoos or a bowl of curd.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening.

name: Mazafati Dates
title: MAZAFATI *dates*
photoBrief: Zunera pouch with a bowl of glossy, near-black Mazafati dates on linen. Warm side light. Portrait 4:5.
description: Mazafati dates come from Iran and are known for their very dark skin and soft, moist flesh. Rich and sweet, with a texture closer to fresh fruit than to a dried date.

notes.Taste: Rich and sweet, with a hint of chocolate.
notes.Best with: Cold milk, or straight from the fridge.

enjoy: Open your fast or your morning with two or three.
Stuff with an almond or pistachio for an easy sweet.
Chop into oats, laddoos or a bowl of curd.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening.

name: Sugai Dates
title: SUGAI *dates*
photoBrief: Zunera pouch with a bowl of two-tone Sugai dates, golden tips and dark bases on linen. Warm side light. Portrait 4:5.
short: Two-tone, with a crisp golden tip.
description: Sugai dates are easy to spot: a dark, soft base and a lighter, crisper tip. That mix of textures, and a sweetness that is never heavy, makes them a favourite across Saudi Arabia.

notes.Texture: Soft at the base, crisp at the tip.
notes.Best with: Arabic coffee or green tea.

enjoy: Open your fast or your morning with two or three.
Stuff with an almond or pistachio for an easy sweet.
Chop into oats, laddoos or a bowl of curd.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening.

name: Tunisian Deglet Nour Dates
title: DEGLET NOUR *dates*
photoBrief: Zunera pouch with a bowl of translucent golden Deglet Nour dates, some still on the stem on linen. Warm side light. Portrait 4:5.
description: Deglet Nour translates as 'date of light', after the way the ripe fruit glows golden when held up to the sun. Semi-dry, with a delicate, honey-like sweetness.

notes.Best with: Cheese boards, salads and baking.

enjoy: Slice into salads with walnuts and greens.
Bake into cakes, breads and cookies.
Serve with cheese and a few almonds.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening.

name: Sukkari Mufatal Dates
title: SUKKARI MUFATAL *dates*
photoBrief: Zunera pouch with a bowl of golden, crystallised Sukkari Mufatal dates on linen. Warm side light. Portrait 4:5.
description: Mufatal Sukkari are Sukkari dates rolled by hand as they dry, which lets their natural sugars crystallise. The result is a golden, crumbly date with a light crunch.

notes.Best with: Bitter coffee or strong chai.

enjoy: Open your fast or your morning with two or three.
Stuff with an almond or pistachio for an easy sweet.
Chop into oats, laddoos or a bowl of curd.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening.

description: Mabroom dates are long and slim, with a reddish-brown skin. They are semi-dry and chewy rather than sticky, with a mellow sweetness.

notes.Best with: Black coffee or a handful of nuts.

enjoy: Open your fast or your morning with two or three.
Stuff with an almond or pistachio for an easy sweet.

storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening.

title: KALMI *dates*
photoBrief: Zunera pouch with a bowl of long, very dark Kalmi dates on linen. Warm side light. Portrait 4:5.
description: Kalmi dates, also known as Safawi, are long and very dark, almost black. Soft and moist, with a lighter sweetness than many dates, they make a good everyday date.

notes.Taste: Lightly sweet, a little like molasses.
notes.Best with: Warm milk or black coffee.

enjoy: Open your fast or your morning with two or three.
Stuff with an almond or pistachio for an easy sweet.
Chop into oats, laddoos or a bowl of curd.

description: Khalas dates are amber to golden-brown, soft and smooth, with a flavour often compared to caramel and butterscotch. A much-loved table date in the Gulf.

notes.Best with: Arabic coffee or black tea.

enjoy: Open your fast or your morning with two or three.

title: KHUDRI *dates*

short: Dark, firm and good for every day.
description: Khudri dates are oblong and dark brown, with a firm skin and a semi-dry, chewy flesh. Mild in sweetness, they are a popular everyday date in Saudi Arabia.

notes.Best with: A glass of milk or a bowl of oats.

enjoy: Open your fast or your morning with two or three.
Stuff with an almond or pistachio for an easy sweet.
Chop into oats, laddoos or a bowl of curd.

description: Rabia dates are long and dark, with a soft-to-chewy texture and a moderate sweetness.

notes.Best with: Black coffee or chai.

enjoy: Open your fast or your morning with two or three.
Stuff with an almond or pistachio for an easy sweet.

title: SUFRI *dates*
photoBrief: Zunera pouch with a bowl of light-brown Sufri dates on linen. Warm side light. Portrait 4:5.
description: Sufri dates are medium-sized and light brown, semi-dry with a pleasant chew. Their sweetness is gentle, so they suit anyone who likes a lighter date.

notes.Best with: Green tea or black coffee.

enjoy: Open your fast or your morning with two or three.
Stuff with an almond or pistachio for an easy sweet.

title: MASHROOK *dates*
photoBrief: Zunera pouch with a bowl of semi-dry Mashrook dates on linen. Warm side light. Portrait 4:5.
description: Mashrook dates are a semi-dry variety with a firm, chewy flesh and a lighter sweetness. Easy to carry and easy to snack on.

notes.Best with: Chai or black coffee.

enjoy: Open your fast or your morning with two or three.
Stuff with an almond or pistachio for an easy sweet.

storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening.

name: Fard Dates
title: FARD *dates*
photoBrief: Zunera pouch with a bowl of dark-brown, semi-dry Fard dates on linen. Warm side light. Portrait 4:5.
short: Dark, firm and not too sweet.
description: Fard dates are dark brown and semi-dry, with a firm bite and a mild sweetness. They keep well, which makes them a good date to have in the cupboard.

notes.Best with: Chai, or chopped into oats.

enjoy: Open your fast or your morning with two or three.
Stuff with an almond or pistachio for an easy sweet.
Chop into oats, laddoos or a bowl of curd.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening.

name: Almonds
title: WHOLE *almonds*
photoBrief: Zunera almond pouch standing on travertine with a stone bowl of whole almonds beside it. Warm, golden-hour side light. Portrait 4:5.
description: Whole almonds chosen for size and snap. We sort each lot for uniform kernels and pack them fresh, so the last handful in the pouch is as crisp as the first.

notes.Taste: Clean and nutty with a light natural sweetness.
notes.Best with: Soaked overnight, or roasted with a pinch of salt.

enjoy: Soak a handful overnight and peel in the morning.
Sliver over kheer, phirni or halwa.
Blend into badam milk with saffron and cardamom.
storage: Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place.

name: Cashews
title: WHOLE *cashews*
photoBrief: Zunera cashew pouch with a wicker basket of whole white cashews, linen drape behind. Soft warm light. Portrait 4:5.
description: Whole cashews graded for colour and size. Sorted to keep broken pieces out of the pack, so what you pour into the bowl looks as good as it tastes.

notes.Best with: Chai, a light roast in ghee, or a rich gravy.

enjoy: Roast in a little ghee with pepper and salt.
Grind into a paste for korma and shahi gravies.
Press onto kaju katli, barfi and cookies.
storage: Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place.

name: Pistachios
title: IN-SHELL *pistachios*
photoBrief: Zunera pistachio pouch beside a ceramic bowl of in-shell pistachios, a few cracked open on stone. Warm daylight. Portrait 4:5.
description: In-shell pistachios selected for naturally split shells and a full green kernel. Sorted by hand and packed quickly to keep them fresh.

notes.Taste: Rich and buttery with a gentle sweetness.
notes.Best with: Evening chai, or crushed over desserts.

enjoy: Shell and share. They rarely last the evening.
Crush over kulfi, rabri or ice cream.
Fold into pulao with saffron and raisins.
storage: Store in an airtight container away from moisture.

name: Seedless Black Raisins
title: SEEDLESS BLACK *raisins*
photoBrief: Zunera raisin pouch with a brass bowl of seedless black raisins on linen. Sunlit, warm tones. Portrait 4:5.
description: Raisins chosen for plumpness and colour, cleaned and sorted to remove stems. Naturally sweet, with nothing we would need to hide on the label.

notes.Taste: Deep and rich, with a natural sweetness.
notes.Best with: Curd, kheer, or straight from the pouch.

enjoy: Soak overnight and have first thing.
Fry in ghee and scatter over halwa and pulao.
Toss through salads, oats and trail mix.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Reseal after opening.

name: Seeded Black Raisins
title: SEEDED BLACK *raisins*
photoBrief: Zunera raisin pouch with a brass bowl of large seeded black raisins on linen, one split open to show the seeds. Sunlit, warm tones. Portrait 4:5.
short: Bigger, with the seeds left in.
description: Seeded black raisins are larger and meatier than seedless ones, with a deeper flavour. The small seeds are left in, so soak them first or eat around them.

notes.Taste: Deep and rich, with a natural sweetness.
notes.Texture: Large and fleshy, with small seeds.
notes.Best with: Warm milk, or soaked overnight.

enjoy: Soak overnight and have first thing.
Remove the seeds and add to kheer or halwa.
Have a few with a glass of warm milk.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Reseal after opening.

name: Figs
title: DRIED *figs*
photoBrief: Zunera anjeer pouch with a stone plate of dried fig rounds, one torn open to show the seeds. Warm low light. Portrait 4:5.
short: Soft anjeer with a honeyed centre.
description: Dried figs, or anjeer, graded by size and softness. Each piece is checked by hand before it is packed, because a good fig should give a little when you press it.

notes.Best with: Warm milk, cheese, or a square of dark chocolate.

enjoy: Soak two overnight and have them in the morning.
Simmer in milk for anjeer doodh.
Slice onto toast, salads and cheese boards.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate in humid weather.

name: Apricots
title: DRIED *apricots*
photoBrief: Zunera apricot pouch with a wicker basket of bright orange dried apricots, green leaves at the edge. Golden-hour light. Portrait 4:5.
description: Dried apricots selected for colour and softness. Sorted piece by piece so the pack holds whole, tender fruit with a clean, bright flavour.

notes.Best with: Yoghurt, nuts, or a slow stew.

enjoy: Keep a few in your bag for the afternoon.
Stew into khubani ka meetha.
Chop into granola, cakes and couscous.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Reseal after opening.
